title: KeyManifestProduction
description: Production key manifest for the BANZA trust path (PKI). Publishes ONLY public keys and their domains (root, issuing, revocation), validity windows, and a content hash for tamper-evidence. Private keys NEVER appear in this artifact and are never transmitted. At M2_PROTOCOL_IMPLEMENTATION no real production keys exist: keys are prepared-but-gated placeholders until the offline root-key ceremony is executed under the approved custody model. Publishing a key manifest does not activate any operator, does not process payments, and does not move funds. BANZA is an open protocol.
_boundary: Production of the BANZA protocol, not financial production. BANZA is an open protocol; it does not process payments, settle value, or move funds. Licence/authorisation belongs to the operator, not to BANZA.

manifest_version.description: Version of this key manifest document.

protocol_version.description: BANZA protocol version the manifest applies to (e.g. '1.0.0').

root.description: Reference to the root of trust. The root key is generated only during the gated offline ceremony; here it is a public reference and fingerprint.

kid.description: Key id of the root key.

fingerprint.description: Public fingerprint (hash) of the root public key. No private material.

ceremony_ref.description: Reference to the root-key ceremony record. Null until the gated ceremony is executed.

keys.description: Published public keys. Private keys never appear.

public_key.description: Public key material only (base64url). Private keys are NEVER included.

hash.description: Content hash of the manifest for tamper-evidence.

value.description: Hex or base64url digest over the canonical manifest bytes (excluding this field).
